record.paper_title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems
record.context_brief: Bogomolov inequality for a Calabi-Yau complete intersection
record.original_question: Let X be a complete intersection of one cubic hypersurface and two quadric hypersurfaces in P^6. Can one prove a stronger Bogomolov-type inequality for slope semistable torsion-free sheaves on X, analogous to the known stronger inequalities for quintic threefolds and for complete intersections of a quadric and a quartic in P^5, in a form that implies the generalized Bogomolov inequality for tilt semistable objects?

evidence.quote: Is it possible to show a stronger Bogomolov inequality

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X \subset \mathbb{P}^6$ be a smooth Calabi-Yau threefold defined as the complete intersection of one cubic hypersurface and two quadric hypersurfaces. Let $H$ denote the hyperplane class of $X$ inherited from $\mathbb{P}^6$. For a torsion-free coherent sheaf $E$ on $X$, define the slope $\mu_H(E) = H^2 \cdot \mathrm{ch}_1(E) / (H^3 \cdot \mathrm{ch}_0(E))$ (when $\mathrm{ch}_0(E) \neq 0$), and the standard discriminant
$$\Delta_H(E) = H \cdot \mathrm{ch}_1(E)^2 - 2\, H^3 \cdot \mathrm{ch}_0(E) \cdot \mathrm{ch}_2(E).$$
The classical Bogomolov inequality asserts that $\Delta_H(E) \geq 0$ for $\mu_H$-semistable torsion-free sheaves $E$.

For real parameters $\alpha > 0$ and $\beta \in \mathbb{R}$, one considers the twisted Chern character $\mathrm{ch}^\beta = e^{-\beta H} \cdot \mathrm{ch}$ and the tilt-slope
$$\nu_{\alpha,\beta}(E) = \frac{H \cdot \mathrm{ch}_2^\beta(E) - \tfrac{\alpha^2}{2} H^3 \cdot \mathrm{ch}_0^\beta(E)}{H^2 \cdot \mathrm{ch}_1^\beta(E)}.$$
The Bayer–Macrì–Toda generalized Bogomolov–Gieseker inequality conjectures that every $\nu_{\alpha,\beta}$-tilt-semistable object $E \in D^b(X)$ with $\nu_{\alpha,\beta}(E) = 0$ satisfies
$$\mathrm{ch}_3^\beta(E) \leq \frac{\alpha^2}{6} H^2 \cdot \mathrm{ch}_1^\beta(E).$$

Prove a stronger Bogomolov-type inequality (in the spirit of those known for the quintic threefold in $\mathbb{P}^4$ and for the complete intersection of a quadric and a quartic in $\mathbb{P}^5$) for $\mu_H$-semistable torsion-free sheaves on $X$, of sufficient strength to imply the above generalized Bogomolov–Gieseker inequality for all tilt-semistable objects on $X$, thereby producing an open subset of Bridgeland stability conditions on $D^b(X)$.
artifact.status_search_result: Stronger Bogomolov inequalities (sufficient to construct Bridgeland stability conditions) have been established for the quintic threefold and for the (2,4)-complete intersection in P^5 (Liu, 2021/2022, Forum Math. Sigma). A general framework (Li, and Liu via Brill–Noether) reduces such inequalities for many CY complete intersections to curve-theoretic statements, but a direct published result specifically for the (3,2,2) complete intersection in P^6 of this strong form was not located; the problem appears still open.

status_evidence.title: Stability condition on Calabi-Yau threefold of complete intersection of quadratic and quartic hypersurfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Proves a stronger Bogomolov–Gieseker inequality for stable objects on the (2,4) complete intersection CY threefold in P^5 and constructs Bridgeland stability conditions.
status_evidence.claim: Analogous strong inequality is known for the (2,4) CY threefold but the (3,2,2) case in P^6 is posed as a question.

status_evidence.title: Stability conditions on Calabi-Yau threefolds via Brill-Noether theory of curves
status_evidence.snippet: Reduces existence of Bridgeland stability conditions on CY threefolds to a Brill–Noether-type inequality for curves, applicable to broad classes of CY complete intersections.
status_evidence.claim: A general approach exists but the specific stronger Bogomolov inequality on the (3,2,2) CY threefold in P^6 is not explicitly resolved in the located literature.
